_readme: Records are keyed on the full parent. A record is CURRENT iff its dict key equals arm||cell||parent||method reconstructed from its own fields; any record failing that test was written under the superseded key schema 'arm||cell||parent[:60]||method', which collided the batch A/B/C questions -- its `samples` MIX DRAWS FROM DIFFERENT QUESTIONS and its `parent`/`method` name only whichever question created it. Do not read those rows.
